question: What does the Research Attention Prediction (RAP) benchmark measure? Answer in one sentence.
expected_answer: RAP (Research Attention Prediction) measures whether an LLM agent, searching a time-restricted arXiv corpus, can predict the next six months' share of papers across research directions, using 278 AI/ML fields and 1,390 episodes.
